_doc: State parity inventory (loading / empty / error / partial) per screen and panel. Read by apps/raft_flutter/test/state_parity_guard_test.dart. screens[].states[]: state = loading|empty|error|partial; variant = optional short text; web = yes|no (does the Web component render a DISTINCT such state); flutter = yes|partial|missing; parityCase = case ids or globs without the theme suffix (e.g. components.list-pages.saved.phone-*); status = covered (needs >=1 parityCase that resolves) | gap (needs justification and size S|M|L) | intentional / na (need justification) | fixing (being fixed in the current branch: needs justification and parityCase; resolution is skipped until it is flipped to covered). Optional: gapKind = case-missing (Flutter has it, no case) | impl-diff (Flutter differs from Web) | invalid-case (case exists but the Web capture does not show the state); caseValidity = react-checked (the cached React capture was inspected and shows the state) | invalid | unchecked. navigationCoverage maps every NavigationRegistry section id and settings tab id to the screen ids that cover it (or a justification string). Add a screen entry (and its states) whenever a screen or panel is added; a registry id that is not mapped fails the guard.

screens.title: Artifact Android download and save
screens.webEntry: Android WebView DownloadListener and system DocumentsUI; native-only orchestration (Artifact service source is not public)

states.variant: destination picker / transfer / complete destination write
states.justification: A native Android download response opens one system save picker, then a scoped transfer progress banner. Canonical Banner/Button/TransferBar components are reused. Local HTTP and file readback tests cover orchestration; Android device validation is still separate.

No download notice or pending transfer survives closing and reopening the viewer. The report remains visible after dismissing a completed save; artifact_download_viewer_test covers actual actions at narrow mouse and expanded touch sizes.

states.variant: network failure / refused foreign origin or redirect
states.justification: Retry reopens the picker and removes the error after full file write. Foreign origins are refused without carrying Artifact cookies; local tests verify zero requests to the foreign server. This native banner is not a replica of an unpublished Artifact-service screen.

states.variant: cancelled / complete file awaiting notice dismissal
states.justification: A cancelled picker fetches nothing; cancelling or closing before native commit removes private partial bytes and the new Android document. A late cancel after native commit preserves the complete file and reports Saved. Widgets prove report return and fresh reopen; provider behavior requires Android acceptance.
